test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is: **Option (1): ZCA** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1a4b2ca4ca2aaa6bc82775ca12b5af46a9b586d9ee9db05b80073e6185c1a72.png] **Option (2): GJH**
